components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The page's one main action, such as starting the first lesson.
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #fff; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1e40af; }

components.description: Supporting actions next to a primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; background: #fff; color: #111827; font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Status Pills
components.description: The state of a lesson, step or quiz; the colour names the state and nothing else.
components.html: جاهز قيد البناء في الانتظار أعد المحاولة مرفوض
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4rem; height: 1.5rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-dot { width: 0.4rem; height: 0.4rem; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; } .ds-pill-ready { background: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; } .ds-pill-building { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-pill-building .ds-dot { animation: ds-breathe 1.6s cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1) infinite; } .ds-pill-waiting { background: #f3f4f6; color: #5f6877; } .ds-pill-waiting .ds-dot { opacity: 0.55; } .ds-pill-attn { background: #fffbeb; color: #b45309; } .ds-pill-failed { background: #fef2f2; color: #b91c1c; } @keyframes ds-breathe { 50% { opacity: 0.35; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-pill-building .ds-dot { animation: none; } }

components.name: Source Row
components.description: A source with its provenance: language badge, isolated title and SPDX licence with its verified state.
components.html: ENPython for Data AnalysisCC-BY-4.0

components.css: .ds-module { border-bottom: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-module summary { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 16px 0; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; } .ds-mod-title { flex: 1; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 700; color: #111827; } .ds-mod-meta { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #5f6877; } .ds-pill-ready-sm { padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 999px; background: #ecfdf5; color: #047857; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-lesson { display: block; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 8px; color: #111827; text-decoration: none; font-size: 0.9375rem; } .ds-lesson:hover { background: #f3f4f6; } .ds-lesson:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: -2px; }

components.css: .ds-feed { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; } .ds-feed-item { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 12px 0; animation: ds-arrive 720ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-feed-item p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.9375rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #111827; } .ds-feed-item time { font-size: 0.75rem; color: #5f6877; } .ds-feed-dot { flex: none; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin-top: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #2563eb; } .ds-feed-done .ds-feed-dot { background: #059669; } @keyframes ds-arrive { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(4px); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-feed-item { animation: none; } }

components.name: Navigation Rail
components.description: Icon-only rail on the right; the active route is tinted Study Blue and carries aria-current.
components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px; width: 4rem; padding: 12px; background: #fff; border-inline-start: 1px solid #e5e7eb; } .ds-rail a { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 10px; color: #4b5563; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-rail a:hover { background: #f3f4f6; color: #111827; } .ds-rail a[aria-current="page"] { background: #eff6ff; color: #1d4ed8; } .ds-rail a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
The product is the category standard for learning apps, built at the polish of Duolingo, Notion and Coursera or Khan Academy, and written Arabic-first. Ahmed chose that register on purpose over three distinctive worlds. The distinction is precision, not novelty: a white page, ink type, one blue, and a course that visibly assembles from licensed sources while the learner watches.

The density is calm and document-like. The plan is a page you read, with disclosure rows rather than a grid of cards, and a narrow pinned column («ما يحدث الآن») that narrates the agents' work in plain Arabic. The technical layer (models, costs, latency) lives in a drawer behind a tab on the left edge. It covers exactly the activity column when open, so one layer replaces the other.

Rejected on record: generic dashboard filler (stat tiles, charts for their own sake), wireframe-grey placeholders, busy screens and novelty styling.
keyCharacteristics: White surface, ink text, one blue accent; status colours appear only where they mean a state.
Arabic leads; foreign text is always isolated and set in its own script's face.
Learner numbers in Arabic-Indic digits, technical numbers in Western tabular digits.
One container elevation, either a border or a soft shadow, never both.
Calm exponential ease-out motion, none under reduced motion.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue that is not a state. A second accent never enters the palette.

rules.name: The Status Means State Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and red appear only on an element whose state they name. Never use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Script Face Rule
rules.body: Foreign text carries its `lang` and is isolated with `<bdi>` or `dir="auto"`. `:lang(en|ru|fr)` switches to the Latin face and `:lang(zh)` to the CJK face.

rules.name: The Two Digit Systems Rule
rules.body: Learner-facing numbers use Arabic-Indic digits (٤٥ دقيقة). Trace values (cost, latency, ids, model names) use Western digits with tabular numerals.

rules.name: The No Dot Separator Rule
rules.body: Never put a middle dot «·» beside Arabic-Indic digits, because it reads as ٠. Separate meta with the hairline separator component.

rules.name: The One Layer Rule
rules.body: The trace drawer is exactly as wide as the activity column and overlays it. It never pushes or squeezes the page.

rules.name: The One Elevation Rule
rules.body: A container takes a 1px hairline border or a shadow, never both.

dos: Do take every colour, radius, space and motion value from the tokens in `src/app/globals.css`.
Do isolate every foreign-language string with `<bdi>` or `dir="auto"` and give it its `lang`.
Do show provenance on every source: language badge, title, SPDX licence and its verified state.
Do use the exponential ease-out (`cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) from an already-visible default, and switch motion off under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Do give disabled actions a one-line reason for what unlocks them.
donts: Don't add stat tiles, charts or progress rings as decoration. This is the generic dashboard Ahmed rejected.
Don't put a label or eyebrow above a heading, or use gradient text, glass, coloured side stripes or emoji.
Don't use a middle dot «·» beside Arabic-Indic digits.
Don't give a container both a border and a shadow, or nest cards.
Don't put model names, costs or latency in learner-facing text outside the trace drawer.
